component.name: Knowing Jesus Today
component.summary: The Holy Bible and the Orthodox faith, also without internet

description.p: A whole app of its own: the Holy Bible in many languages with search, comparison and listening; the Holy Fathers beside every chapter and their writings to read like books; the Bible Dictionary; the Bible Maps in the land's real colours with the story maps; Today with God with the readings of the day.
Everything is kept on your computer and works without the internet. Sign in to keep your bookmarks, colours, notes and Study Pads in step with My KJT on the website and your phone.

screenshot.caption: The Holy Bible with the Holy Fathers beside it
Bible Maps: the journeys of St Paul

description.p: Steadier: right click (or a long press) chooses the verse and shows the one action bar, now with words beside its icons; the maps use less memory; if the app ever freezes, a small log shows where.

A richer reader: it always opens on the Holy Bible and offers to continue at the very verse where you stopped; choose a book, a chapter and a verse; books coloured by their kind with a legend; right click (or a long press) on a verse for everything you can do with it; cross-references; the Greek and Hebrew words with their meanings; the words of Christ in red; your notes under their verses; the people and places of each chapter.
Faster, simpler and more modern: its own icons, smooth maps, pages that open at once, downloads four files at a time, and a layout that fits small screens and phones.
A new app, made for the computer: no web pages any more. Signing in to My KJT works in the app.
